{"id":1887786536,"question_id":3325,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months","timestamp":1768657723,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"91 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1887786536/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find the Largest Area of Square Inside Two Rectangles","memory":"59.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int getmaxside(vector<int>&bl1 , vector<int>&tr1 , vector<int>&bl2 , vector<int>&tr2)\n    {\n        int intersect_xb = max(bl1[0], bl2[0]);\n        int intersect_yb = max(bl1[1], bl2[1]);\n\n        int intersect_xu = min(tr1[0], tr2[0]);\n        int intersect_yu = min(tr1[1], tr2[1]);\n\n        int overlapW = intersect_xu - intersect_xb;\n        int overlapH = intersect_yu - intersect_yb;\n\n        if(overlapW <= 0 or overlapH <= 0) return 0;\n        return min(overlapW, overlapH);\n    }\n\n    long long largestSquareArea(vector<vector<int>>& bottomLeft, vector<vector<int>>& topRight) {\n        int n = bottomLeft.size();\n        int maxside = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = i+1 ; j<n ; j++)\n            {\n                int side = getmaxside(bottomLeft[i] , topRight[i] , bottomLeft[j] , topRight[j]);\n                maxside = max(maxside , side);\n            }\n        }\n    return 1LL * maxside * maxside;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-largest-area-of-square-inside-two-rectangles","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1503}
